question: Can a finite full-width A change be jointly compensated by B on two explicit image-free LN domains, using variable projection rather than a fixed reflection? Single feasibility pilot,not a completed defense.
domain_definition: G=diag(gamma)^-1 V_A;N spans null(1^T G);Q=orth(G N). Thus Q is centered and diag(gamma)Q lies in span(V_A). Use complete resulting subspace,not selected directions.
radius: sqrt(768) in normalized centered pre-affine LN coordinates;task dimension31/full767
parameterization: deltaA=(I-U_AU_A.T)Z(I-RR.T), R=orth([V_A,beta]);normalize deltaA to fixed relative norm1. InitialZ is the projection of originalA. Biases frozen. B correction lies in V_B complement. SameB for both domains.
optimizer_scope: Standard SciPy L-BFGS-B on sphere-normalized A;envelope gradient and exact shared convex B. No new optimizer or novelty claim.
acceptance: Report both initial/final source errors and independent8192-vector errors after unique point freeze. ProbeRMS1% and Bbound are only feasibility criteria,not a true task or security guarantee. Failure preserved;no seed/rank/layer/range retries. No real-image or partner information used for optimization.
limitations: One-block feasibility calculation,not a whole-model release or accuracy result. Full task preservation and TA/originalAGA remain separate. Current old data-assisted variants remain closed.
origin: Current novel combination under investigation;SVD,variable projection,sphere constraints and minimax are standard tools. Does not retry any old fixed reflection point.
